blocks.text: Lists slicing (list ka hissa lena) aur concatenation (+ se lists jorna) jaise amal bhi karti hain.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
part = numbers[1:4]    # items at index 1 to 3
combined = part + [6, 7]
print(combined)    # [2, 3, 4, 6, 7]

blocks.prompt: Class activity: books = ["To Kill a Mockingbird", "1984", "The Great Gatsby", "Pride and Prejudice"]. "Moby Dick" jorein, "1984" ko "Brave New World" se badlein, "The Great Gatsby" hatayein, ["War and Peace", "Hamlet"] se milayein aur print karein. Nateeja kya hai?
blocks.explanation: books.append("Moby Dick"); books[1] = "Brave New World"; books.remove("The Great Gatsby"); books = books + ["War and Peace", "Hamlet"]; list: To Kill a Mockingbird, Brave New World, Pride and Prejudice, Moby Dick, War and Peace, Hamlet.

blocks.prompt: Do lists ko kaunsa amal jorta hai (MCQ 10)?

items: Slicing list[a:b] (b shamil nahi); + lists jorta hai; sort aur remove saath chal sakte hain.
